prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a hit while turning left. The patient had 9 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1049; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a collision sustained while turning left, with the mechanism of injury consistent with the reported crash. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm a fracture of the wrist. No prior injury to the same body area is known from the history obtained. Care was delivered over nine visits and followed a standard course, with immobilization, pain management, and progressive range-of-motion exercises. Visit frequency tapered as the patient's symptoms and function improved. Billing records reflect single, non-duplicated charges for each service rendered. The patient was discharged to self-directed home exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur or worsen. Follow-up recommendations include continued monitoring of grip strength and wrist mobility until full recovery is documented.
